notes: Multi Studio version 2.3.2: **Smooth 60–120 FPS Transcript & Playlist Scrolling**: Dramatically optimized UI rendering performance for large transcripts (500–2,000+ segments) and multi-file playlists by extracting memoized segment components and applying CSS content visibility containment. The browser now skips off-screen DOM calculations, delivering fluid, lag-free scrolling and eliminating frame stutter during audio playback., **Auto-Wait & Resume on Cloud Rate Limits (HTTP 429)**: Batch playlist transcription now automatically handles Google Cloud Vertex AI rate limits (RPM / token quotas). When a temporary rate limit is encountered, the playlist enters an automatic cooldown with a live visual countdown timer (25s → 45s → 60s) and resumes seamlessly without aborting the queue or marking files as failed., **Independent Cross-Platform Auto-Updates**: Updated the auto-updater system with isolated platform-specific update manifests (`updater-{{target}}-{{arch}}.json`), ensuring macOS and Windows builds check their own operating system updates independently so single-platform releases never cause update errors, broken signatures, or missed updates on the other platform., **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Model**: Added Google's new dedicated speech-to-text model, delivering word-level timestamp accuracy and superior transcription for short and medium video captions., **Caption & Subtitle Timing for Gemini Transcriber**: You can now choose between Sentence, Short Captions (TikTok & Reels), Medium Captions (YouTube), and Custom Character Limits when transcribing with Gemini, generating perfectly timed subtitles that match your chosen style., **Enhanced Multi-Language Recognition for Gemini Transcriber**: Upgraded Gemini language prompting with tailored native script instructions, tone guidelines, and punctuation rules across 20+ languages (including Khmer, Thai, Lao, Burmese, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and European languages)., **Burst-Safe Dual-Stream Concurrency for Gemini 2.5**: Tuned Gemini 2.5 batch concurrency to 2 parallel streams with a 2-second stagger delay, eliminating initial burst rate limit collisions on large playlists while maintaining high-speed parallel transcription., **Duration-Aware Adaptive Pacing for Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**: Automatically scales inter-file cooling buffers based on audio length (3.5s for short clips up to 14s for long audio), preventing token exhaustion against Google Cloud's 60-second sliding quota window., **Unified Subtitle Timing Controls**: Standardized the timing controls so that both Cloud (Gemini) and Local (Whisper) transcription share the exact same presets and custom limits., **Dedicated Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Architecture & Endpoint Routing**: Configured the Vertex AI backend to route Gemini 3.5 Transcribe to its official `v1beta1` global endpoint using native `audioTranscriptionConfig`, converting word-level timestamps directly into millisecond-accurate subtitle cuts without drift., **Natural Native Phrasing & Punctuation for Continuous Scripts**: Upgraded prompts and subtitle word assembly for Southeast Asian languages (Khmer, Thai, Lao, Burmese, etc.) to produce natural phrasing spaces at spoken breath pauses and proper native punctuation (such as Khmer Khan "។" and Thai clause spacing) instead of artificial unspaced walls of text., **Streamlined Language Selector & Quick Search**: Redesigned the language selection dropdown with instant search filtering, region flags, and native script badges, removing intrusive hover tooltips for a cleaner, faster workflow., **Full-Height Responsive Playlist Layout**: Expanded the playlist box to fill the vertical space of the AI Transcriber sidebar, docking action buttons cleanly at the bottom., **Cloud Transcription Models & Preview Support**: Set Gemini 2.5 Flash as the default recommended model for reliable instant transcription, alongside Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Preview with global endpoint routing., **Strict Model Integrity for Transcription**: Transcription strictly executes the user-selected model without silent fallback to other models, ensuring transparent error reporting and predictable subtitle results., **Proactive Pacing & Sequential Cloud Queue**: Cloud transcription now paces Gemini 3.5 Transcribe with a 4.5s buffer between audio files to stay safely within Google Cloud's preview 5–10 RPM threshold, preventing concurrent request collisions and quota spikes when transcribing multi-file playlists., **Accurate Error Reporting Without Masking**: Resolved an issue where rate limit errors (HTTP 429) were overwritten with false "Model Not Found" (HTTP 404) messages during endpoint fallback checks., **Professional 3-Column Resizable Workspace**: Reorganized the AI Transcriber into a native 3-column resizable layout with Shadcn splitters: left for the playlist and queue actions, middle for synchronized audio playback and transcript preview, and right for engine, model, timing, and language configurations., **Persistent Layout & Collapsible Sidebars**: The AI Transcriber now remembers your adjusted column widths across restarts and features one-click buttons to collapse or expand the playlist and configuration sidebars whenever you need extra workspace., **Fixed Export Button Overflow**: Streamlined the Transcript Output export button with a compact badge and responsive boundary sizing, preventing badges from clipping or overflowing the toolbar card., **Docked Export & Output in Playlist Panel**: Restored the Transcript Output card, timestamps toggle, Copy All, and Export controls to the bottom of the left playlist panel, keeping the middle transcript preview canvas completely unobstructed., **Classic Export Design with Non-Forcing Toggles**: Restored the familiar export interface with dynamic status badges (`[ ZIP ]`, `[ FULL ]`, `[ PARTS ]`, and `[ SRT ]`), the original popover configuration layout with separate checkboxes, and fixed the toggle logic so unchecking options no longer force-selects other items., **Improved Language Selector & Popover Positioning**: Upgraded the spoken language selector to use Radix UI Popover with automatic collision avoidance and viewport anchoring, preventing dropdown options from rendering off-screen or backwards. Reordered the settings panel to place Language Selection logically between AI Engine/Model and Caption Timing., **Natural Punctuation Without Forced Characters**: Removed artificial post-processing logic that was forcefully appending Khmer Khan ("។") to the end of every subtitle segment. Refined transcription guidelines so Khmer, Thai, and continuous scripts follow authentic spoken speech pauses and cadence rather than robotic, repetitive punctuation marks., **Natural Continuous Script Spacing in Auto-Detect**: Added intelligent Unicode script detection for Khmer, Thai, Lao, and Burmese so that selecting "Auto-Detect" preserves native continuous phrasing instead of incorrectly inserting a space between every word ("1 word 1 space"). Refined Gemini prompts to strictly avoid robotic word-by-word spacing in continuous scripts., **Removed Artificial 24-Hour Quota Lockout**: Removed the legacy Google AI Studio daily quota limit countdown and 24-hour lockout timer from the AI Transcriber playlist. Google Cloud Vertex AI uses cloud pay-per-use without daily quotas; temporary rate limits (HTTP 429) are now reported clearly without locking users out of their workspace., **Transparent Google Cloud Error Reporting**: Replaced generic template error messages with direct, unmasked Google Cloud Vertex AI API responses, allowing users to inspect the exact HTTP 429 quota metrics and rate limit details returned by Google Cloud., **Model-Adaptive Queue Concurrency**: Automatically adapts transcription concurrency based on the selected AI model: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe executes with 1 dedicated sequential stream and a cooling buffer to respect Google Cloud preview limits, while Gemini 2.5 Flash and Pro run concurrent multi-file batch streams for fast parallel transcription., **Accurate Subtitle Exporting**: Exporting to SRT or TXT now preserves your chosen caption lengths directly without unintended text combining., **Legacy AI Studio 24-Hour Quota Countdown**: Removed the hardcoded 24-hour quota countdown banner and localStorage lockout timer from the playlist panel., **Redundant Gemini Khmer Tip Box**: Removed the informational Khmer transcription tip banner when using Cloud (Gemini), keeping the sidebar clean and spacious while retaining the advisory only when Local (Whisper) is selected., **Legacy Segment Timing Box**: Removed the old static segment timing display and leftover background merge logic in favor of the new universal caption timing presets.
